brand.name: Tehsil Sahayak
brand.office: Revenue department · Demo tehsil, Sample district

login.title: Officer sign in
login.subtitle: This is a training console. The applications are fictional. The officer records the final decision.
login.invalid: The email or password is not correct.

queue.title: Today's queue
queue.subtitle: Files with a broken high-severity condition come first, then files closest to the time limit.
queue.orderHint: Order: severe condition, then fewer days left, then the older application.

file.notFound: This application is not in your department.
file.noHistory: No decision has been recorded yet.
file.slaRule: The disposal time limit is {days} days.

assist.title: Review assistance
assist.disclaimer: This is only a suggestion. A certificate is created only when you record an approval.
assist.sourceTemplate: The summary is written directly from the conditions.
assist.sourceModel: A language model wrote the summary from these conditions. The decision still comes from the rules.
assist.summaryApprovedFlags: No blocking condition failed, but look at the marked points.
assist.summaryReturned: The file is incomplete or inconsistent. It can be returned for correction.
assist.summaryRejected: The income ceiling is crossed. A file like this is rejected.
assist.chatHint: The answer uses only this application's details and conditions. You can ask more than one question.
assist.chatPlaceholder: How far is the income above the limit?
assist.chatUnavailable: No answer just now. The conditions are listed above.

actions.noteHint: Write at least one sentence for a rejection, a return, or a decision that differs from the suggestion.
actions.noteMissing: Write a note for this decision.
actions.closed: A final decision is already recorded on this file.
actions.overridden: Your decision differed from the suggestion.

findings.duplicate_identity: Open application {reference} already exists for this identity number.
findings.threshold_diff: {left} and {right} differ by more than the {percent} percent limit.

certificate.title: Income certificate
certificate.body: This is to certify that {name}, father or spouse {relation}, resident of {locality}, has a declared annual family income of {income}. Purpose: {purpose}.
certificate.footer: This is not a valid certificate from a revenue office. It was created for training only.
